State Witness Statement - S-01
Date: November 1, 2024
Witness: John Smith

I, the undersigned, hereby declare under penalty of perjury that the following is true and correct:
On October 15, 2024, I was present at the scene of the crime at Lakeside Market, where I observed defendant Petri engaged in armed robbery. Petri was seen with a firearm and demanded money from the register. I immediately alerted security and called 911.

This statement is true to the best of my knowledge and belief.

_________________________
John Smith

State Witness Statement - S-03
Date: November 1, 2024
Witness: Robert Johnson

I am the security guard at Lakeside Market. When I received the call about the robbery, I immediately locked down the premises and contacted police. The witness S-01 was waiting at the entrance when I arrived. Detective Miller arrived shortly after and interviewed both witnesses. The defendant's getaway vehicle was identified by the security camera footage.

_________________________
Robert Johnson

State Witness Statement - S-02
Date: November 1, 2024
Witness: Jane Doe

I declare that I was the storekeeper at Lakeside Market on October 15, 2024. The defendant entered the store with a gun and insisted on money. I handed over the cash register and Petri fled the scene within two minutes.

_________________________
Jane Doe
